propositions: Gerrit Verify runs consistently show 35-second setup duration for test_server_binds_loopback_only, dominated by synchronous socket.getfqdn reverse-DNS lookup of numeric 127.0.0.1 in ThreadingHTTPServer constructor on macOS.

Nested timing instrumentation around editor server constructor, TCP bind, and getfqdn calls must distinguish which operation owns the ~35s delay without altering test behavior or external dependencies.

Fixture-setup observer emitting worker id, node id, fixture name, and monotonic elapsed time only for spans above 1 second threshold must be armed by CI environment variable or explicit REBAR_FIXTURE_TIMING=1 and remain silent otherwise.

Root-cause hypothesis discriminates between getfqdn reverse-DNS (~35s), TCP bind milliseconds, _no_repo_commits fixture, and generic worker starvation through deterministic tests and first post-merge organic macOS/Ubuntu observation.
